Coolant systems containing deposits or contamination prevent effective cool- ing of parts. Contamination and deposits must be regularly eliminated. This comprises the following: Cleaning the system and, if required, removal of limescale deposits, flushing the system. Cleaning The coolant system must be checked for contamination at regular intervals.
